components.name: Filled Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.0107em; } .ds-btn-filled { background: #1a73e8; color: #fff; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-filled:hover { background: #1967d2; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(60,64,67,0.3), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(60,64,67,0.15); } .ds-btn-filled:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a73e8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-filled:active { background: #185abc; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #dadce0; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #1967d2; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(26,115,232,0.08); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a73e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Labelled text input with a 40px control height.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-field span { color: #5f6368; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #80868b; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #202124; font-size: 14px; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #202124; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1a73e8; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #1a73e8; }

components.name: Status (ok)
components.description: Icon-plus-label status; colour never carries meaning alone.
components.html: Online
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #202124; font-size: 14px; } .ds-status-icon { flex: none; vertical-align: middle; }

components.name: Chip (tonal)
components.description: Pill-shaped tag for counts, roles and filters.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f1f3f4; color: #202124; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, hairline-bordered container for grouped content.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #dadce0; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; } .ds-card-header { padding: 16px 20px 12px; } .ds-card-header h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Google Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-body { padding: 4px 20px 20px; }

components.name: Navigation Drawer Item
components.description: 256px drawer row; active item gets a primary-container fill.
components.css: .ds-drawer-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 20px; color: #202124; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-drawer-item:hover { background: rgba(60,64,67,0.06); } .ds-drawer-item[aria-current='page'] { background: #e8f0fe; color: #1967d2; }

narrative.overview: Spawnpoint is played straight in the Google Cloud console grammar: an app bar carrying a scope chip, a navigation drawer, a worlds list that opens into a world page, and every fact placed on a labelled detail row. It is a resource console, not a game dashboard — it refuses neon stat cards around a giant Start button, and it refuses the discarded incumbent's single-world command surface behind a breadcrumb picker. Depth is conveyed by hairline borders and tonal fills, not by neumorphic or offset shadows; the one reserved shadow is functional, not decorative, and appears only on temporary top-layer surfaces (menu, dialog, sheet, snackbar). The content pane has no max width by design: it fills wide and 4K viewports the way the real Cloud console's resource tables do. Density comes from a 48px table row rhythm, an underline-tab pattern, and status rows that never rely on colour alone.
keyCharacteristics: White app bar and drawer over a Grey-50 canvas, hairline borders throughout.
Google Blue reserved for actions, links and selection only — never decoration.
Status is always an icon plus a label; unlit states (Archived, Not created) are drawn on purpose, not left blank.
Flat surfaces at rest; one shadow vocabulary for transient top-layer chrome only.
No content-pane max-width: tables and detail pages fill the viewport.

rules.name: The Icon-Plus-Label Rule
rules.body: Every status (ok, progress, off, unknown, ready, error, warning, info, archived, absent, pending) pairs a Material filled glyph with a text label. Colour alone never carries meaning.

rules.name: The Drawn Unlit State Rule
rules.body: Archived (do_not_disturb_on) and Not created (add_circle_outline) are designed ghost states with their own icon and secondary-ink colour, not a blank table cell.

rules.name: The Three-Face Rule
rules.body: Titles are Google Sans Flex, everything functional is Roboto, everything precise is Roboto Mono. No component borrows a fourth face or a system display font.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces (app bar, drawer, cards, tables, banners) are flat with a hairline border. Shadow appears only on menu, dialog, sheet and snackbar.

dos: Do pair every status with a Material filled icon and a label (ok, progress, off, unknown, ready, error, warning, info, archived, absent, pending) — never colour alone.
Do draw unlit states (Archived, Not created, no address) as their own icon-and-label state, not an empty cell.
Do keep the content pane unconstrained in width; it is a resource console, not a centred marketing column.
Do reserve shadow for menu, dialog, sheet and snackbar; every other surface stays flat with a hairline border.
Do use Google Sans Flex only for titles; Roboto for everything functional; Roboto Mono for anything precise or comparable.
donts: Don't use Google Blue as a background fill outside containers, selection and controls — it marks action and state, not decoration.
Don't add a shadow to a persistent surface (card, table, app bar, drawer) to fake depth; use the hairline border and tonal fill instead.
Don't cap the content pane's width; the 4K and wide-viewport case is a design target, not an overflow to hide.
Don't introduce a kicker/eyebrow label, a hard-offset neobrutalist shadow, or a system display face; none exist in the build and none should be added.
